text:
incident-bot: Paging eng-oncall: SEV2 - KV cache growth + continuous-batching amplification. Error rate spike & autoscale thrash seen in us-west-2. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/kv-batch

maya: On it. Looking at metrics now. KV cache entries 120k -> 1.2M in ~3m. batch_queue_depth ~2000, avg latency up 800ms, 5xx spike ~3%. GPU pods scaling up/down repeatedly.

jamal: This looks like continuous batching holding prefixes and causing cache blowup. Temporary mitigation: turn off continuous batching feature flag and restart runtime pods (avoid touching GPUs).

olga: Doing that now.

olga: ```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/runtime ENABLE_CONTINUOUS_BATCHING=false
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/runtime
``` 

deploy-bot: Config change applied by olga at 1978642105: ENABLE_CONTINUOUS_BATCHING=false

olga: Restart done. runtime pod CPU dropped from 65% -> 22%. batch_queue_depth -> ~180. GPUs still see scale oscillation due to warmup/COLD starts.

leo: HPA thrash explanation: scale-up events for warmup push CPU over threshold then immediate scale-down. We should add scaleDown stabilization and bump targetUtilization to avoid oscillation.

jamal: Proposed HPA patch:
```
kubectl patch hpa inference-runtime --type='json' -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/behavior/scaleDown/stabilizationWindowSeconds","value":300}]'
kubectl patch hpa inference-runtime --type='json' -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/metrics/0/resource/target/averageUtilization","value":70}]'
``` 

maya: Also raise minReplicas to 3 until we stabilize: `kubectl scale deployment runtime --replicas=3 -n inference`

olga: Applied HPA stabilization and scaled minReplicas=3. Patch finished at 1978642184.

olga: Error rate falling back to baseline. Some customers saw degraded latency: CUST-9811, CUST-1102; support notified.

maya: Support update: support case 2345 opened, customers advised of mitigation. No data exfiltration, only latency/errors.

jamal: Additional short-term tweak: disable KVCACHE_WARMUP on warmup-controller to avoid extra load while we analyze.

olga: ```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/warmup-controller KVCACHE_WARMUP_DISABLED=true
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/warmup-controller
``` 

deploy-bot: Warmup toggle rolling out.

incident-bot: Status update - mitigated. SEV2 -> monitoring. Action items: 1) postmortem, 2) add alert for kv cache growth rate, 3) add HPA hysteresis in baseline, 4) improve batch size heuristic.

jamal: Handoff to @oncall-next. Summary: KV cache blowup driven by continuous batching under hot prefixes caused autoscale thrash. Temporary fixes applied: continuous batching OFF, HPA stabilization, minReplicas=3, warmup disabled. Monitor for 2 hours and start postmortem draft.

oncall-next: Taking over. I'll keep an eye on scale events and validate HPA behavior in prod canary. Will confirm once stable. Thanks.

maya: I'll assemble logs/metrics and link artifacts: /artifacts/incidents/1978642000. Will ping once postmortem draft is up.

olga: Thanks all. Follow-up: permanent plan needs improved batching heuristic + KV eviction limits. I'll add to eng-runtime backlog.
